preview.youAreJupiter: You encourage Bird when they speak up, meet new people, or try something unfamiliar, and they tend to feel more relaxed and sure of themselves around you. As Bird responds to that support, you offer even more reassurance, but they can start depending on your encouragement to feel confident or enter situations without thinking much because they assume you will keep backing them. Around you, Bird can give themselves permission to feel everything: grief, anger, fear, or even hope.
